segments.title: Two riddles. Can you solve them?
segments.say: Riddle time with Oskar from Stockholm, Sweden! Two riddles. Can you solve them?

segments.title: Hands, but can't clap?
segments.say: Riddle one. What has hands, but can't clap?

segments.title: A clock!
segments.say: A clock! Its hands tell the time.

segments.title: Break it before using it?
segments.say: Riddle two. What has to be broken before you can use it?

segments.title: An egg!
segments.say: An egg! Crack it, then cook it.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: Did you get both? Comment below, and follow for more riddles.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
segments.tiny: A new kid, a new riddle
